evals/cases/seedance-2-5.json.86:
"response": "Routing to higgsfield-seedance-2-5 (§ Choosing 2.0 vs 2.5) → higgsfield-seedance.

Seedance 2.5 caps at **720p** — there is no 1080p or 4K lane on it (specs/model-specs.yaml, snapshot 2026-08-07). A 4K deliverable is a **Seedance 2.0** job.

**Model**: Seedance 2.0
**Aspect ratio**: 16:9  **Duration**: 8s  **Resolution**: 4k  **Mode**: std

4K requires `mode=std`; `fast` caps at 480p/720p. If you also need something 2.5-only — a clip over 15s, video editing, or forward/backward extension — structure it on 2.5 at 720p and finish the hero shots on 2.0.",
evals/cases/seedance-2-5.json.188: "request": "My v2v shot of me jumping onto a dragon has failed the same way in all four batches. Should I run more batches?",
evals/cases/seedance-2-5.json.189:
"response": "Routing to higgsfield-seedance-2-5 (VFX-PIPELINE.md § Stage 5).

No — stop batching. The same defect across all four batches is a prompt or source fault, and further batching only burns credits.

The likely cause is an anchor problem: video-to-video inherits motion from the plate, so it can only render an action the plate has an anchor for. If there is no actual jump moment in your source footage, no re-roll will produce one.

The fallback is image-to-video:

1. Screenshot a frame of the location out of the plate.
2. Declare it as the starting frame in the prompt (2.5 has no start_image role — the anchor is a reference whose role sentence says it is the first frame).
3. Write the action from scratch, since nothing is being inherited any more.
4. Write a deliberate empty-frame pause of about 1.5 seconds where you intend to cut — an empty frame is a clean stitch point, and it doubles as a tension beat.",

skills/higgsfield-models/MODELS-DEEP-REF.31: **Strengths:** Longest clip duration on the platform (up to 15s) · native multilingual audio (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish + accents) · superior subject consistency · precise text rendering in video · physics-aware motion (object interactions, hugging, fighting, complex machinery) · AI Director mode understands shot-reverse-shot, cross-cutting, camera blocking from a prompt alone · stylized output engine for anime, Pixar/claymation, felt/fabric textures
